artworks.title: Bathers
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and color crayons
artworks.description: The image portrays a low point of view with two figures in a landscape setting. The horizon is near the top with a band of blue and a golden hue above. The grass is vibrant and textured with loose, expressive brushstrokes in pastel tones and soft pencil outlines. The color palette includes soft greens, purples, and yellows, with the figures sketched in blue and purple. Close to us, two human figures are shown within tall grass or dunes; one kneels while the other stands with raised arms. Dense greenery frames the scene, emphasizing the interaction between humans and nature.

artworks.title: Nude Figure of a Boy in a Landscape (Knabe zwischen Blattpflanzen)
artworks.description: The painting shows an abstract figure surrounded by flora. The black and white artwork features a human-like figure in the center, with patterned leaves and possibly flowers around them. The figure is simplified and stylized, depicted in a seated pose with distinct lines. The background includes a jagged line that could represent mountains or a stylized horizon.

artworks.title: Nude Figure of a Girl in a Landscape (Madchenzwischen Blattpflanzen)
artworks.description: The image is a black and white illustration featuring a person seated from head to knees, with knees bent and arms resting on the knees. The person has minimalistic facial features, short bobbed hair with geometric patterns, and is not wearing clothing. Surrounding the figure are decorative foliage with exaggerated leaves. The backdrop shows abstract shapes above the figure, with Otto Mueller's signature at the bottom right.

artworks.title: Knut Hamsun
artworks.description: The image is a portrait sketch of a man. The sketch shows his head, partial neck, distinctive mustache, and neatly combed hair. His facial features are prominently displayed, including his eyes looking directly at the viewer, well-defined eyebrows. There are no visible clothing or objects in the image, and the background is plain and neutral.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a formal suit with a bow tie, sitting or standing at a slight angle. He has short, neatly combed hair and a serious expression. His hands are in the foreground, holding a small object. The background is a textured surface.

artworks.title: Under the Oaks
artworks.description: The image displays a tree-lined pathway from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is formed by the arching branches of the trees, guiding the eye toward the sky. The scene is captured in an etching style with intricate cross-hatching and line work creating texture and depth in the foliage and shadows. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of sepia for contrast. Individuals can be seen walking along the path, their forms outlined by linework that adds to the interplay of light and shadow.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a woman in a seated position, viewed in a three-quarter profile. Her head is slightly tilted with a gentle expression on her face. She has soft facial features with wavy hair styled away from her face, giving her a poised and elegant appearance. The clothing is depicted through undefined lines. No visible jewelry or objects are held by the person. The background is a plain beige.

artworks.title: Death as Juggler (Revolution) (Tod als Jongleur [Revolution])
artworks.medium: woodcut, printed in blue-black, with opaque watercolor on wove paper

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.description: This image depicts a landscape with a low horizon, featuring stylized buildings, trees, and a field. The painting is done in bold brushstrokes in a watercolor style, with a color palette of earth tones, greens, browns, blues, and grays. The sky shows layered clouds with shades of blue and gray.

artworks.title: Old Man
artworks.description: This print shows an abstract representation of a person from the waist up. The person is facing forward, with angular, stylized facial features, including a prominent brow, deep-set eyes, a pronounced nose, and tightly set, thin lips. Their hair is dark and closely cropped. Clothing is indicated by strong, textured lines that suggest a substantial garment, possibly a coat or a cloak, and there is a suggestion of the person's hand near their chest, folded into a fist. The background features heavy, textured lines and shading. The print is in thick lines of black, dark red, and off-white.

artworks.title: Return of the Prodigal Son
artworks.description: The image is a woodcut art showing two figures. The figure on the left is seated or crouched on the ground, seen from the back and slightly from the side. This figure appears gaunt with visible facial features like a prominent nose and open mouth. They have short, textured hair. The other figure is standing, leaning forward towards the seated figure. This figure is dressed in a long-sleeved shirt, full-length trousers, has a long beard, and wears a head covering. The scene is in a monochromatic color palette with a rough, abstract background. There are no visible jewelry or objects in the figures' hands.

artworks.title: Deliberation (Beratung)
artworks.medium: woodcut in green with black crayon
artworks.description: This abstract image features bold curved and angular lines that define shapes resembling people engaged in conversation or interaction. The figures are outlined with thick strokes, suggesting faces and limbs in motion. The central figure appears to be gesturing with hands outlined by distinct finger-like shapes, evoking hands in discussion or persuasion. The overall composition may suggest a gathering or assembly, with each form contributing to a narrative of human interaction or dialogue.

artworks.title: Deliberation (Beratung)
artworks.description: This is a painting of abstract figures engaged in interaction. The composition consists of three prominent figures outlined with bold, dark strokes on a lighter background. The central figure displays verticality and an intricate pattern within the outlines, suggesting a flowing garment or robe. To the left and right of this central figure, additional figures seem to interact with the central figure, with overlapping forms creating a sense of depth. The artwork uses strong, expressive brushwork and delineation with striking contrast. The figures are rendered in a simplified manner, focusing on form and gesture, in the style of Ernst Ludwig Kirchner.

artworks.title: Frontispiece: The Dregs of Society (Les bas-fonds de la societe)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various allegorical scenes and figures sketched around a central theme. The full-description of the image shows a large book-like structure in the center with the text "Bas les Masques de la Societe, par Joseph Prudhomme Photographe a Paris." A jester leans on the book next to a theatrical mask. Other vignettes surround the central figure, depicting a range of activities or interactions. In the foreground, there is a figure on a pedestal labeled "Verite" (Truth), with birds flying nearby.

artworks.title: The Falconer (La fauconniere)
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a person depicted from about the hips up, positioned in profile. They are standing and facing to the right, with their right arm raised and bent at the elbow while holding an object that resembles a torch with a flame or ornament on top. Their left arm is bent with the hand resting on their hip. The facial features are not distinctly detailed, but the person seems to have long, dark hair flowing behind them, and they are wearing a helmet with a decorative crest. The clothing appears to be draped loosely, suggestive of classical attire. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or other objects they are interacting with besides the object in their hand. In the lower right corner, there is a smaller sketch of a head wearing a helmet. The background of the image is plain, with no additional elements.

artworks.title: The Sparrow of Lesbie (Le moineau de Lesbie)
artworks.description: The image is an illustration of a person reclining against a stone block. The person's upper body and legs are visible. One arm rests on their head while the other is draped across their torso. The person has a contemplative expression and short hair covered by a headpiece. They wear a loose garment starting at their waist. Foliage details surround them, along with a bird perched nearby. Beneath the stone block is a small winged, cherub-like figure on the ground. The background is plain with few details.

artworks.title: Oude-Kate
artworks.description: This image features an elderly woman seated and shown from the knees up. Her body is angled slightly to the side, with one knee crossed over the other as she holds a knife in one hand while appearing to peel vegetables. Her face is detailed with deep lines, suggesting age, and she has a thoughtful expression with a focused gaze. Her hair is not visible as it is covered by a headscarf. The woman's clothing consists of a simple, long-sleeved dress with loose-fitting sleeves and a high collar. Next to her, there is a basket containing a number of round objects. The background is dark and textured, emphasizing the figure and her immediate surroundings without providing much additional detail.

artworks.title: Le Rydeack
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing near a doorway. She appears soft-faced with a subtle expression and has an intricate updo and hat. She wears a long dark dress with ruffled layers and a patterned blouse with puffy sleeves. In her right hand, she holds an apple with her ring finger extended. Beside her is a figure holding an umbrella. The background is a dimly lit, indoor space with square lamps and a large window with grid-like panes.

artworks.title: Satan Sowing Tare (Satan semant l'ivraie)
artworks.description: This print depicts a tall, elongated figure walking across a landscape beneath a dark sky. The figure wears a wide-brimmed hat, a loose, flowing garment, and clog-like shoes with pointed, upturned toes. They have long hair and limbs that are exaggeratedly long and thin. We can't see their face. They are facing the right, with one leg in front of the other as if they are mid-step. Their left hand holds a bundle of cloth to their chest, either the flowing train of their garment or some kind of bag. The shapes of small people appear to fall out of this flowing cloth towards the ground below. In their outstretched right hand, they hold two of these small people, holding them over the ground as if about to drop them. The landscape below appears to be a dark cityscape, with some rooftops and towers visible. There is also a pale river with bridges stretching across it. The sky above is shadowy, with a pale moon or sun on the right partially covered by dark clouds.

artworks.title: Evening (Le soir)
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene overlooking water from an elevated angle. The horizon is high in the composition, separating water and sky. A pier extends towards the horizon, with a three-masted sailing ship in the left distance. The artwork uses Pointillist brushstrokes, creating a mosaic-like texture. The color palette includes soft pastel hues of blues, greens, and pinks, creating a serene atmosphere. Small boats with colorful sails are on the water, reflecting the same stippled technique. To the right, a large structure, possibly a lighthouse or pier, casts shadows. In the distance, ships with full sails are visible under the subtly colored sky.

artworks.title: In the Park
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people interacting in a park-like setting viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The scene is framed by tall trees and lush foliage, with figures placed at various depths. The artwork uses pointillism technique with small dots of color applied systematically to create the image. The brushstrokes form distinct patterns and offer texture. The color palette includes yellows, blues, greens, reds, and pinks, creating a warm atmosphere. Closest to us is a seated figure in light blue with another figure in a shaded cloak, both surrounded by green grass. In the distance, an orange horse is among several people dressed in Victorian-style garments under the tree shadows.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.description: The image is a black and white sketch showing a portrait of a man's upper body. He is positioned facing slightly to the right with a direct gaze towards the viewer. The man has a strong jawline, a full mustache, and beard. He has wavy hair styled upwards and wears eyeglasses. He is dressed in a suit with a bow tie, conveying formality. The background is minimal with simple line shading.

artworks.title: Calm Excursion
artworks.description: The image shows an outdoor scene featuring a man wearing a hat sitting on grass by a water body, with his back facing us. A cane lies beside him. A duck is floating in the water nearby, along with another bird. In the background, a rowboat with two passengers paddling is visible, while a strip of trees and a classical pavilion stand out near the horizon. The etching uses fine lines and crosshatching for texture, with a monochromatic color palette of various shades of gray highlighting the serene scene and reflections in the water.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a path where a person walks a dog. The viewpoint is from above, showing the path, a person, a dog, and a distant horizon with trees and small buildings. The style uses black ink strokes on a beige background, creating texture and depth. The image has no color, giving it a classic, serene rural feel.
